rules.text: Speed Seals: d8s equal to 1 + proficiency bonus (the pool), back on any rest. Two Blitz Arts (+1 at 7th and 15th): the option items.

activities.label: Blink of an Eye
activities.text: Start of your turn: teleport within your speed; adjacent hostile creatures. Failure: −2 AC until the start of your next turn. Attacking one this turn: 1 more Speed Seal teleports you back.

activities.label: Blitz Assault
activities.text: Once per turn, attacking with a jutsu: one more attack of the same type; on a hit this, and the jutsu's non-damage effect again.

activities.label: Flash Dodge
activities.text: Reaction to damage, up to 2 Speed Seals: +2 AC each (also against the trigger) until the start of your next turn (one seal: the effect; two: raise it to +4).

roll.note: Start of your turn: the Dash action; hostile effects can't reduce your speed this turn.
Once per turn, dealing wind or lightning: teleport next to another creature within 30 feet and make one unarmed or weapon attack, + the seal's d8.
Reaction, making a Strength or Constitution save: make a Dexterity save instead.
Rolling initiative: add twice the result.

activities.label: Speed Amplification
activities.text: Start of your turn: ignore difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

roll.note: Once per turn on your turn: an extra Action this turn. Each use raises its cost by 1 until a long rest (spend the extra by hand).
Bonus action: mark a weapon you wield for 1 hour (no seal spent).
Bonus action: teleport to the marked weapon within 120 feet.

Once per turn, a weapon or melee attack's damage: the creature is marked for 1 minute (Marked: your Hijutsu's Interdiction Seal options; Triangulate: the first attack on it each turn +1 critical range).

activities.label: Interdiction
activities.text: Reaction, a marked creature you can see casts an HS jutsu: detonate the seal (it's no longer marked). Failure: its jutsu is Interrupted and 1 rank of Sealed (2 at 11th).

rules.text: (Its copy of Speed Sovereign's Amp is removed, as King Q-E12.)

activities.label: Speed Sovereign
activities.text: Bonus action, 1 minute, once per long rest.

roll.note: Start of each of your turns.

roll.note: Reaction: reduce the damage instance by this.

activities.label: Interdiction Seal: detonation

activities.label: Aura of Quickness
activities.text: In combat, concentration: creatures you choose starting their turn in your 15-foot radius gain +10 speed (+10 per rank) until the start of your next turn. Exploring: 1 hour, normal pace counts as fast.

roll.note: Reaction, until the start of your next turn, the first damage each turn: 1 DR 4 on that instance; 2 DR 6 on each instance this turn; 3 resistance on each; 4 immunity to the trigger.
Once per turn, at its start or end: teleport to a creature or object marked with your Speed Seal within 120 feet.

rules.text: You gain the release you didn't pick for Swift Release Affinity (set it on the sheet); Wind or Lightning jutsu can swap their damage between wind and lightning when you roll.

activities.label: Mirror Image
activities.text: Three duplicates (+1 at B, +2 at S) for 1 minute; a Bonus action dismisses them. Each attack on you: a d8 per duplicate; a 4+ (6+ against True Sight, Tremorsense or Chakra Sight) hits a duplicate instead.

roll.note: One per remaining duplicate.

castOptions.label: Interdiction Seal
castOptions.note: On a creature marked with your Speed Seal: dispel a clone for +1d4 to your attack on it; its attacks on you hit a duplicate on 2 less.

activities.label: Shadowless Flight (Ninjutsu)
activities.text: One attack against every creature marked with your Speed Seal within 120 feet; wind or lightning. B-Rank: teleport next to one damaged creature.

roll.note: Concentration: at the end of each of your turns, 5+ vanishes you into your pocket dimension until the start of your next turn (return within 10 feet).

activities.label: Spatial Wall
activities.text: A wall within 60 feet (30 by 20 by 1 feet, or a 20-foot cylinder): repels creatures; ranged attacks and shaped Ninjutsu passing through or from inside turn back on their caster (not Genjutsu). Upkeep is its full cost.

activities.label: Speed Siphon
activities.text: A creature you can see within 60 feet, at the start of each of its turns. Failure: Slowed and Dazed (they don't end early; disadvantage on its attacks); a success ends both until its next save.

castOptions.label: Interdiction Seal
castOptions.note: On a creature marked with your Speed Seal: each success it makes gives −1 on its saves (stacks to −4).

activities.label: Thunder Flash
activities.text: Move along a 30 by 5-foot line without provoking; each creature you pass. Failure: 6d6 wind or lightning (Taijutsu DC: [Unarmed]/[Weapon Damage] + 3d6); success: half.

castOptions.label: Interdiction Seal
castOptions.note: On a creature marked with your Speed Seal: passing through it: +15 feet and you can change direction.

roll.note: Once per turn, Reaction, one of two marked creatures attacks or casts: swap their places first (out of range: a new target, or it misses / is Interrupted); both seals are dispelled.

Once per turn, Reaction, a marked creature's attack or jutsu would damage you or inflict a Physical or Elemental condition: dispel its seal + 1 Speed Seal; a Dexterity save against its attack result or save DC; success avoids it, you teleport next to it and can cast a 1-Action attack jutsu at it.
